fichas.title: Vehicles—Turning
fichas.summary: Guidance and illustrated layouts for vehicle turning places, including hammerheads, turning circles and loops. Circles and loops are preferred for trucks because they allow a one-swing turn. Layouts should account for vehicle overhangs and avoid fixed-object hazards. The page includes vehicle external-dimension data and recommendations for external turning-circle radii by road type and use.
uses: Provide turning areas for cars, refuse collection vehicles, fire engines, HGVs, buses and other vehicles.
Allow vehicles to turn without excessive reversing or hazardous manoeuvres.
Determine turning-circle radii appropriate to road type, zone use and design vehicle.
